scope: Pure selection from explicit reviewed metadata; no new source, API, build, or runtime execution

inputs.contract: Researcher-supplied common purpose, consumer identity/stage/object role, required effective configuration, comparable execution context, and ordered semantic provider features
inputs.profiles: Version, architecture, hash-bound actual configuration facts, legal applicability review, reviewed purpose/consumer/provider bindings, adapter availability, and positive integer cost
inputs.example_pool: Only the four existing s390_arch_contract_20261013 runtime profiles; config/autoconf/build metadata and existing pre-run protocols
inputs.manual_inputs: Legality, common consumer equivalence, architecture provider semantics, context equivalence, and feature priority are reviewed researcher inputs; this module does not infer them from source
inputs.evidence_status: Hash-bound metadata/review attestation is not independent proof of source semantics or present-day bootability

selection.version: Require identical revision; old/fixed strings are opaque identifiers, never a ranking feature
selection.comparability: Require different architecture, identical common purpose/consumer identity/stage/object role and execution context matching the contract
selection.legality: Require status=legal, externally reviewed exact profile binding, verified effective config facts and required values; unknown is excluded, never normal
selection.provider_contrast: Require a difference in at least one complete, reviewed contract-relevant semantic feature; architecture name, source path, provider signature alone are insufficient
selection.ranking: Lexicographically prefer differences in the contract's ordered features, then lower pair cost, then SHA256(seed + sorted profile IDs); architecture names, outcomes, version labels, and input order are not ranking inputs
selection.budget: max_pairs=1 and max_cost=2 for the known example; pair cost sums both profile costs without shared-run discounts; reject nonpositive/bool budgets and costs; preserve reasons for every profile and pair
selection.non_selected: Report structural incompatibility and explicit budget exclusion; no automatic substitution of unknowns

prior_contact: This is development on already-read known material, not a blind experiment. This turn read existing pre-run protocols containing prior expectations and the first 150 lines of the existing runtime runner to locate metadata; no new runtime results/events were read. Expectations and observer code do not enter selector inputs.
evaluation: Offline synthetic boundary cases are method tests, not defects. Save example pool and selection before any optional later runtime-result replay. No claim of new finding, generalization, detection accuracy, or independent N2 innovation.
pre_example_review_amendment: Before example collection/selection, independent review required binding profile IDs and costs as well as factual/semantic inputs, because they influence ties and budgets. Explicit architecture/path/signature/version/outcome feature names are rejected. This denylist does not recognize arbitrary renamed leakage; genuine feature semantics still require external review. Initial 24-test pass is preserved separately, with targeted additions after this correction.
completion: Executable pure selector, meaningful boundary tests, and metadata example with artifact hashes plus saved selection or explicit insufficiency. Original core modules/results/notes remain unchanged by this subtask.
